assumptions: Persons are deterministically addressable from world, settlement and birth ordinal when the aggregate model provides the required addressable population context.
Only explicitly retained bounded state persists across eviction/revisit.
limitations: Household grouping is model-derived and is not a kinship claim.
Genealogy remains UNKNOWN unless explicit retained lineage exists.
Culture represents bounded structured conventions and knowledge topics, not real language, belief or historical truth.
Individual actions are proposals only and require governed P4/gameplay admission.

fidelity.validity: Bounded deterministic individual refinement over an already modeled civilization/demography aggregate.
fidelity.resolution: At most 128 simultaneously materialized persons per refinement call with bounded memories, ties, skills and conventions.
fidelity.uncertainty: Unretained genealogy, detailed biography, beliefs, language and unsupported demographic facts remain unknown rather than fabricated.
